artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined path with a distant structure on the horizon. The path is lined with curved trees and lush foliage creating an archway above. The fine etching technique portrays detailed textures of leaves and tree bark. The color scheme is monochromatic with black lines on a beige background. A musician plays near a small dog, and a couple walks down the path. In the distance, more figures and a building are visible under the foliage.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a view of a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is visible, with hills rising above it and a village nestled on the horizon. The artwork features intricate line work typical of etching, conveying texture and depth through lines and hatching. The monochrome color palette consists of blacks and browns on a cream background. A figure walks with a dog, and a row of buildings is depicted along with trees framing the scene. The land extends into gentle slopes with structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a low vantage point across a body of water towards a distant city scene. The horizon line separates the cityscape from the sky. The city features towers and rounded structures, with a prominent tower. Textured rocks are depicted on the left. Boats are in the water, including a small boat with sails nearby and larger sailing vessels further away. The etching uses fine lines and detailing with a monochrome palette. The sky has wispy clouds outlined with fine lines.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated point of view showing an expansive village setting. A church is centrally positioned, with a steeple appearing on the horizon and surrounding buildings. A cluster of trees is present, merging with the sky seamlessly. The technique involves intricate detailing of the village and its elements with delicate brushstrokes or etching lines, creating a textured effect. The scene is monochromatic, using varying intensities of sepia tones for depth. A circular basin or trough is the main focus, with a person and a cow nearby. Figures and a cart are on the left, and a building frames the edge on the right, leading to the village street.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, buildings, trees, and a shepherd with sheep. The sky is dominated by clouds, and the foreground features detailed trees with fine brushstrokes. The color palette is neutral with dark ink on a cream background.

artworks.title: Entry of M. de Macey
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.2 × 11.5 cm (3 1/4 × 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of musicians playing instruments. The scene depicts five figures engaged in musical activities, such as playing the drum and flute. The figures are dressed in flowing garments with exaggerated feathered hats. The detailed line work captures the energy and movement of the figures. The background is minimal, focusing attention on the interaction of the figures, balanced with carefully placed lines above that hint at musical rhythm or notation.

artworks.title: The Small Carrying of the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to oval image): 4.3 × 5.8 cm (1 11/16 × 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing features a detailed scene showing a large group of people engaging in various activities in a landscape with hills and structures. The figures hold banners, flags, and objects, with some on an elevated platform or hill. There is a sense of movement and activity, with figures arranged in rows and groups. The artwork's fine lines and intricate details suggest an engraving or etching technique. The scene seems to depict a significant moment involving a bustling crowd and historic architecture.

artworks.title: Noble Woman in Profile with her Hands in a Muff
artworks.description: The image displays a woman standing upright, facing the right side. She has fine facial features, styled hair, and is dressed in an elaborate outfit with a fur muff in her hands. The background shows a village scene with buildings, trees, and small figures of people moving around.

artworks.title: Soldier with Feathered Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently with a slight right-facing stance. He has his hands resting on a detailed hilt resembling a sword. He has a bearded face, pointed chin, mustache, styled hair, and wears an extravagant hat with a plume. He wears a coat with a ruffled collar, puffed sleeves, billowing trousers tucked into tall boots with visible spurs. The background shows a dynamic scene with figures on horseback and foot in a landscape with swirling smoke or foliage.

artworks.title: Beggar Couple
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.3 × 8 cm (4 7/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing close together. The figure on the left is dressed in a layered outfit with a cape, trousers, and a hat, while the figure on the right wears a gown with a cloak or shawl and a bonnet. Both figures hold a walking stick and have their facial features obscured by shadows. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Couple, with Landscape in Background
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.5 × 8 cm (4 1/2 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted walking. The figure on the left is a man shown from head to toe, holding a walking stick in his right hand. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak draped over his shoulders, covering a tunic. The woman on the right is shown in full height, with a headdress and long dress. She carries a bundle under her right arm. The background includes sparse trees and grass.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.5 × 8 cm (4 1/2 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly person walking with a cane in their right hand and carrying a small pot in their left hand. They are slightly hunched over and wearing a headscarf, a long dress with long sleeves, and an apron. The background includes stone walls and sparse vegetation, with a small bush in the foreground.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman and Child
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.2 × 7.9 cm (4 7/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing on a slightly elevated natural surface. On the left is an adult facing right and holding a staff or walking stick. This person is wearing a head covering and loose, draped clothing that reveals their bare feet. The figure on the right is a child dressed in similar clothing and a large brimmed hat obscuring their face. The child is standing slightly away from the adult. The background is simple with minimal details like horizontal lines and a few plants at the foreground edges.

artworks.title: The Card Players
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table. The oval drawing depicts several figures engaged around a table with various objects and papers placed upon it. The scene is rendered in a style suggesting intricate detail and dramatic lighting, reminiscent of etching or engraving from the Baroque period. The figures wear elaborate clothing with ornate hats, capes, and feathered accessories. A harp is present in the background. The border of the image contains inscriptions or text in Latin. The scene is steeped in shadow, creating a theatrical atmosphere with light illuminating parts of the table and the figures involved in what appears to be a tense or clandestine interaction.

artworks.title: Noble Woman Wearing a Veil and a Dress Trimmed in Fur
artworks.description: The image portrays a person in full length standing in profile facing right. The person wears an elaborate headpiece covering their hair, and their facial features are delicately drawn. They are dressed in a long cloak with intricate detailing and a large muff covering their hands. The cloak seems to be lined or trimmed with fur at the bottom. In the background, there is a bustling town with various buildings, some with steeples, and miniature depictions of people and animals. The drawing is bordered, framing the central figure and the scene behind.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Fur Plastron
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in an engraved artwork. The person is facing slightly towards the right with their hands by their sides. They have a mustache, distinctive facial features, long hair flowing from under a large hat with a feather. The person wears elaborate clothing including a fur collar, a belted doublet, voluminous pants, and high boots with spurs. A sword hangs at their side. The background shows a town scene with buildings and people engaged in various activities, some possibly in conflict or dance-like movements. The setting appears historic, lively with numerous figures and architectural elements throughout.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Mantle Trimmed in Fur, Holding his Hands Behind his Back
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an elaborate outfit with a hat, coat, fur lining, knee-high boots, and a straight sword, striking a dramatic pose. He faces left, with distinct facial features including a hooked nose and protruding chin. His hair flows beneath the hat, and he is set against a background of a town square with people, buildings, and animals.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with Large Collar
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright with a composed posture. They have their left hand rested on the hip and the right hand hanging naturally. The individual has an oval face with shoulder-length, wavy hair and is wearing an elaborate gown with puffed sleeves and a large collar. The clothing has intricate patterns and textures. They also wear a necklace with a triangular pendant. The background shows distant buildings and trees sketched along the horizon.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with Fan
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person standing. She is shown in a frontal view with her hands placed together in front of her. The person has a gentle expression, dark, short, curly hair, and is wearing an elaborate dress with various details and a high collar. There are decorative elements on the dress, puffed sleeves, and intricate patterns. Additionally, she wears a necklace and is standing in front of a background with buildings and small figures.

artworks.title: Noble Man Wrapped in a Mantle Trimmed with Fur
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He has distinct facial features, with a pointed mustache and chin beard, and flowing hair that peeks out from beneath a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a plume. He is dressed in an elaborate, fur-trimmed cloak that envelops his upper body, coupled with puffed pants that tighten at the knee. On his feet are decorative shoes, and he holds what appears to be a sword by his side. The background features a detailed landscape with small buildings, a bridge, and trees, suggesting a rural or town setting, with soft hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Folded Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile facing right. He has his hands clasped in front of him and his head slightly bowed. The man has a prominent nose and a slight chin, with shoulder-length hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a coat with a fur collar, knee-length breeches, and rosette-adorned shoes. The background depicts a bustling urban setting with people, buildings, arches, towers, a bridge, and a town square.

artworks.title: Masked Noble Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a formal pose with their hands positioned at the waist holding a small bouquet of flowers. The person has an intricate hairstyle, wearing a mask that covers the upper half of their face, leaving their mouth and chin visible with earrings. They wear an elaborate long gown with patterns, voluminous sleeves, lace cuffs, and a layered collar. The background includes small groups of people, buildings, a fountain, and multi-story structures, resembling a town square setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Battle Scene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 10.1 cm (2 5/16 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with trees in the foreground and soldiers in armor lined up from right to left. In the distance, there is a city or town with smoke rising into the sky. The scene conveys action and movement. In the foreground, there are heavily armored figures on horseback among the trees. The artwork demonstrates detailed lines and textures, evident in the smoke and tree foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of sepia and dark ink. The background features lighter lines depicting a smoky sky, contrasting with the more detailed elements in the foreground.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Pilgrims
artworks.dimensions: sheet (tirmmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 10.1 cm (2 5/16 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon line is high, focusing on a mountainous landscape with structures. Two figures are using surveying instruments, one looking through a device while the other stands nearby. Trees frame the figures on the right, with an incomplete building or ruin on the left. In the distance, hills and mountains are visible. The artwork uses fine, etched lines for texture and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing line intensity for dimension.
